   City Council Meeting Agenda
  Tuesday, February 18, 2020

   CALL TO ORDER
   PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE LED BY: Council Member Liao
   ROLL CALL: Mayor Pu, Vice Mayor Menchaca, Council Members Costanzo,
  Harrington, Liao

 1. APPROVAL OF AGENDA ORDER

 2. PRESENTATIONS

  A. INTRODUCTION OF POLICE OFFICER DOMINIC SALMON
  B. INTRODUCTION OF POLICE OFFICER DIEGO CORTEZ
  C. PROMOTION OF FIRE DIVISION CHIEF BRADLEY DAVIS
  D. PROMOTION OF FIRE ENGINEER TAKAHIRO SUZUKI
  E. RECOGNITION OF PLANNING MANAGER TRACY STEINKRUGER
  F. MEASURE SG UPDATE

 3. PUBLIC COMMENT

  This is the time set aside for members of the public to address the City Council
  on items of interest that are not on the Agenda, but are within the subject matter
  jurisdiction of the San Gabriel City Council. Pursuant to the Brown Act, the City
  Council cannot answer any questions or take any action until such time as the
  matter may appear as an item on a future agenda.

  In an effort to provide everyone with an opportunity to speak tonight, please be
  aware that all public comments will be limited to a maximum of three minutes.
  You will receive a 30-second warning as you approach the end of your time. As a
  reminder, please be respectful of all speakers regardless of the position they take
  on any items.

  If you wish to address the City Council, please complete a speaker’s request card
  and hand it to the clerk before the start of the meeting. When speaking, please
  state your NAME for the record.

 4. CONSENT CALENDAR

  All items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and
  recommendations will be approved in one motion unless a member of the
  City Council or audience requests separate discussion.

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – February 18, 2020  2
   A. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  The minutes are a record of the official actions taken at the City Council
  meeting.

  1. Minutes of the City Council Regular Meeting of February 4, 2020.

  Recommended Action: Approval.

  B. MATERIAL DEMANDS

  This is the presentation of the “Register of Demands and Warrants” for the
  payment of City expenditures.

  Recommended Action: Approval.

  C. CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT – JANUARY 2020

  This is a presentation of City investments for the month of January 2020.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the Cash and
  Investment Report for January 2020.

  D. AGREEMENT FOR USE OF SMITH PARK POOL BY SAN GABRIEL UNIFIED
  SCHOOL DISTRICT FOR GABRIELINO HIGH SCHOOL 2019-2020 SCHOOL
  YEAR

  The San Gabriel Unified School District has requested renewal of their contract
  for the use of the Smith Park pool for the 2019-2020 school year, with a start
  date of February 3, 2020. Gabrielino High School has requested the use of the
  pool from 2:00 p.m. to 4:30 p.m. Monday through Friday, with extended hours
  for home swim meets. As part of the 2019-20 Citywide Fee Schedule which
  was adopted by Resolution No. 19-31, the fee for Gabrielino High School use
  is $40.00 per hour. This includes the hourly cost of one Lifeguard and a portion
  of utilities and maintenance of the pool. The City will bill San Gabriel Unified
  School District in June at the end of the school year. This agreement is
  proposed to end on May 29, 2020.

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – February 18, 2020  3
   Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council approve and authorize the City
  Manager to sign the agreement with San Gabriel Unified School District for
  Gabrielino High School’s use of Smith Park Pool for the 2019-2020 school
  year.

  E. PARKING LICENSE AGREEMENT – 401 SOUTH MISSION DRIVE
  (HUMBERTO FLORES AND JEANNE E RAYA, TRUSTEES OF THE
  HUMBERTO FLORES AND JEANNE E RAYA LIVING TRUST)

  For the last 13 years, the City of San Gabriel has utilized four parking spaces
  located at 401 South Mission Drive for the purposes of parking City owned
  vehicles. Approval of a new agreement will allow for the use of four parking
  spaces for five years at a cost of $1.00 per year to the City.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council approves the continuance of the
  License Agreement with Humberto Flores and Jeanne E Raya, Trustees of the
  Humberto Flores and Jeanne E Raya Living Trust at the cost of $1.00 per year.

 5. PUBLIC HEARING

  A. SAN GABRIEL PLAZA MIXED-USE PROJECT: PLANNED DEVELOPMENT,
  DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT, REQUEST TO VACATE CITY STREETS, AND
  TENTATIVE TRACT MAP NO. 80292; ADOPTION OF MITIGATED
  NEGATIVE DECLARATION AND MITIGATION MONITORING AND
  REPORTING PROGRAM (PLANNING CASE NO. PL-16-162; 220 SOUTH
  SAN GABRIEL BOULEVARD)
  APPLICANT: SAN GABRIEL SQUARE LLC / EDWARD CHANG (MANAGER)

  Attachment A: Proposed Ordinance (including the Development Agreement)
  Attachment B: Application package (REVISED) and plans including TTM No.
  80292
  Attachment C: City Council staff report (April 2, 2019)
  Attachment D: City Council meeting minutes (April 2, 2019)
  Attachment E: Redline language re: Assignment (provided by Developer)
  Attachment F: CEQA Initial Study
  Attachment G: Final MND and MMRP
  Attachment H: Planning Commission Resolution No. 20-01 (January 13, 2020)
  Attachment I: Planning Commission meeting minutes – draft (January 13,

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – February 18, 2020  4
   This is a request for a Planned Development, Development Agreement,
  Request to Vacate City Streets, and Tentative Tract Map No. 80292 to allow
  for the construction of a mixed-use project consisting of 163 residential
  condominium units and 34,835 square feet of retail and restaurant uses on an
  approximately 3.66-acre site generally located at 220 South San Gabriel
  Boulevard.

  These land use entitlements may be approved or denied by the City Council.
  The City Council originally considered the proposed project at a public
  hearing on April 2, 2019 and provided direction to the Applicant, which has
  resulted in changes to both the project description and conditions of
  approval. On January 13, 2020, the Planning Commission, who serves as the
  recommending body, considered the revised project and recommended City
  Council adoption of the relevant environmental documentation and approval
  of the proposed project by a vote of 4-0. Should the project be approved by
  the City Council, the development would be subject to Design Review by the
  Design Review Commission before proceeding to Building Plan Check.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council:

  1. Conduct the public hearing and discuss the proposed Ordinance No. 651;

  2. Motion to waive full reading and introduce the attached Ordinance by title
  only. The City Clerk will read aloud the full title of Ordinance No. 651;

  AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SAN GABRIEL
  TO ADOPT A MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION AND MITIGATION,
  MONITORING, AND REPORTING PROGRAM AND TO APPROVE PROJECT
  NO. PL-16-162, A PLANNED DEVELOPMENT, DEVELOPMENT
  AGREEMENT, REQUEST TO VACATE CITY STREETS, AND TENTATIVE
  TRACT MAP NO. 80292 FOR THE SAN GABRIEL PLAZA MIXED-USE
  PROJECT AT 220 SOUTH SAN GABRIEL BOULEVARD

  3. Motion to approve the First Reading of Ordinance No. 651 and to waive
  future reading of the Ordinance; and

  4. Schedule the Second Reading and adoption of the Ordinance for the next
  regular Council meeting. The Second Reading will require a majority vote
  of the total membership of the Council.

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – February 18, 2020  5
   Should the City Council determine the proposed project or any part of the
  proposed project be denied, the appropriate motion should be adopted.
